description:
Derived performance indicators calculated deterministically from valid measurement windows.
Traceable to raw request records (RawRequestMeasurement).

sample_count.description: Count of completed valid requests analyzed
sample_count.title: Sample Count

failed_request_count.description: Count of failed or aborted requests
failed_request_count.title: Failed Request Count

offered_load_rps.description: Actual rate at which client scheduled requests
offered_load_rps.title: Offered Load Rps

achieved_load_rps.description: Actual completed request throughput over the measurement window
achieved_load_rps.title: Achieved Load Rps

generator_saturated.description: Boolean flag indicating whether client load generator saturated
generator_saturated.title: Generator Saturated

ttft_ms.description: Object containing p50, p90, p95, p99, mean, min, max

itl_ms.description: Object containing p50, p90, p95, p99, mean (with documented aggregation)

e2e_latency_ms.description: Percentiles and summary of total request durations

token_throughput_tps.description: Total output tokens generated per second
token_throughput_tps.title: Token Throughput Tps

error_rate.description: Ratio of failed requests to total offered requests
error_rate.title: Error Rate
